verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution documents one-click, AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of an error and how to fix it. It auto-prompts the LLM (OpenAI or Azure OpenAI, using your own API key) with the stack trace, environment and affected code, and adds a collaborative chat whose conversation can be linked into issue comments. missing for 10: breadcrumbs and related commits are not documented as inputs to the AI analysis (the repo integration is not tied to it), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of how good the root-cause suggestions are.
